source: Written 2026-10-16 from the verified oracle text for every card a scene shows or names (the combo comb's verified list, Scryfall 2026-10-16, and carddb --verify the same day for Mister Fantastic, Brainstorm, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Mind Stone, Chromatic Lantern, Commander's Sphere and Command Tower) and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list; the commander, Mister Fantastic, and Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards are different cards, and every scene keeps them apart. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. The only power and toughness stated is The Thing's printed 7/7 (Scryfall card data): forty +1/+1 counters make it 47/47 (CR 122.1a). Commander starting life is 40 (CR 903.7), and damage to a player is life loss (CR 120.3a). Cards are drawn one at a time, so each card is its own Human Torch trigger (CR 121.2); each damage event triggers The Thing once, each counter event triggers Sue once, and each token creation triggers Reed once (CR 603.2c). Human Torch's 'if you control another Hero' and Mister Fantastic's 'if you've cast a noncreature spell this turn' are intervening-if clauses (CR 603.4). Summoning sickness limits only attacking and {T}/{Q} abilities (CR 302.6): the combat draw works the turn Mister Fantastic arrives, but his copy ability, and The Thing's attack, need them under your control since the turn began. The combat draw happens in the beginning of combat step, before attackers are declared (CR 506.1, 508.1). Valeria's {1} less comes off the generic part of a cost (CR 601.2f). Annie Joins Up makes each triggered ability of a legendary creature you control trigger an additional time (CR 603.2d): one card then gives two Human Torch triggers, four from The Thing, up to eight Walls and up to sixteen Reed draws, and every Wall and Reed draw is still optional. Fiery Emancipation is a replacement effect (CR 614.1a), so each 1-damage ping deals 3. Kill counts assume three opponents at 40: 14 pings of 3 each, 42 pings in all, so 21 cards with both enchantments, 42 with Fiery alone, 60 with Annie alone, 120 with neither. Pensive Professor's draw is mandatory; Iron Man's counter goes on a target you choose, which is how that loop stops. Unstoppable Plan: you control the Plan's trigger and Mister Fantastic's copies of it (CR 707.10); the copies go on the stack above the Plan's own trigger and resolve first (CR 405.5), and the Plan's trigger stays on the stack as a legal target; copies may get new targets (CR 707.10c), and a copy of Human Torch's trigger has Human Torch as its source (CR 707.10b). A copy is put on the stack, not triggered, so Annie adds nothing to it (CR 603.2d, 707.10). With Mister Fantastic untapped when Brainstorm resolves, its three Human Torch triggers sit on the stack while he alternates: a copy of the Plan (two untaps), then a copy of a Torch trigger (two pings). Mana abilities can be activated between resolutions (CR 605.3a), and unspent mana stays until the end step ends (CR 106.4, 500.5): three rocks make 3 mana per untap, so two untaps (6) pay for one activation (4) with 2 kept each round, while two rocks only break even. The end step has no turn-based actions (CR 513.1). Clip 5 teaches the Plan line, not the Niv-Mizzet chain: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary draws that many cards, one per point of damage, so Fiery Emancipation triples the draws as well, and a 120-life table would need about 120 cards from a library that runs out first (CR 121.4, 704.5b).

scenes.head: Mister Fantastic — four-colour Heroes
scenes.sub: His trigger: at the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've cast a noncreature spell this turn, draw a card.
scenes.say: Mister Fantastic, four-colour Heroes. If you've cast a noncreature spell this turn, he draws a card at the beginning of combat.

scenes.head: Turn 3: Mister Fantastic, then [[Sol Ring]]
scenes.sub: [[Arcane Signet]] came down on turn 2. Three lands and the Signet make four: {2}{U} for him, {1} for the Ring.
scenes.say: Turn three. With turn two's Arcane Signet, three lands make four mana: Mister Fantastic, then Sol Ring.

scenes.head: Beginning of combat: draw a card
scenes.sub: You cast a noncreature spell, so he draws. Summoning sickness doesn't stop a trigger: it works the turn he arrives.
scenes.say: Beginning of combat: you cast a noncreature spell, so he draws. Summoning sickness doesn't stop a trigger.

scenes.head: [[Valeria Richards, Precocious|Valeria Richards]]: cheaper spells, more cards
scenes.sub: Noncreature spells you cast cost {1} less. Whenever you cast your first noncreature spell each turn, draw a card.
scenes.say: Valeria Richards: noncreature spells you cast cost one less, and the first one you cast each turn draws a card.

scenes.head: Turn 4: Valeria, then [[Mind Stone]] for {1}
scenes.sub: Seven mana: {3}{U} for her, and the Stone's {2} drops to {1}. Valeria draws, then Mister Fantastic at combat.
scenes.say: Turn four: Valeria, then Mind Stone for just one. Valeria draws a card, and Mister Fantastic draws another at combat.

scenes.head: [[Whirlwind of Thought]]: every spell draws
scenes.sub: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, draw a card. It costs {1}{U}{R}{W}, and [[Valeria Richards, Precocious|Valeria]] takes off the {1}.
scenes.say: Whirlwind of Thought draws a card whenever you cast a noncreature spell. With [[Valeria Richards, Precocious|Valeria]], it costs blue, red and white.

scenes.head: From turn 6: one cheap spell, three cards
scenes.sub: Whirlwind landed on turn 5. Each turn's first noncreature spell now draws with Valeria and Whirlwind, and Mister Fantastic draws a third at combat.
scenes.say: From turn six, one cheap spell is three cards. Valeria and Whirlwind each draw one, and Mister Fantastic draws the third at combat.

scenes.head: Then make the cards hurt
scenes.sub: [[Human Torch, Johnny Storm|Human Torch]]: whenever you draw a card, if you control another Hero, he deals 1 damage to target opponent.
scenes.say: Then make the cards hurt: whenever you draw, Human Torch deals one damage to target opponent, if you control another Hero.

scenes.head: The Fantastic Four: one loop
scenes.sub: Each one's trigger sets off the next. One card drawn becomes damage, two counters, a Wall and another card.
scenes.say: One loop: each of the Four sets off the next. A card becomes damage, counters, a Wall, and another card.

scenes.head: 1. Draw: [[Human Torch, Johnny Storm|Human Torch]] deals 1
scenes.sub: Whenever you draw a card, if you control another Hero, he deals 1 damage to target opponent. All Four are Heroes.
scenes.say: Step one: you draw, so Human Torch deals one damage to target opponent, since you control another Hero.

scenes.head: 2. [[The Thing, Ben Grimm|The Thing]] gets two counters
scenes.sub: Whenever one or more Heroes you control deal damage to a player, put two +1/+1 counters on The Thing. Torch is a Hero.
scenes.say: Step two: a Hero dealt damage to a player, so The Thing gets two +1/+1 counters.

scenes.head: 3. [[Invisible Woman, Sue Storm|Sue Storm]] makes a Wall
scenes.sub: Whenever you put +1/+1 counters on other Heroes you control, you may create a 0/4 Wall token with defender. The Thing counts.
scenes.say: Step three: counters went on another Hero, so Sue may create a zero-four Wall token with defender.

scenes.head: 4. The Wall makes [[Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards|Reed]] draw
scenes.sub: Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, you may draw a card. That card sets off Human Torch again.
scenes.say: Step four: a token entered, so Reed may draw a card, and that card sets off Human Torch again.

scenes.head: One pass. You choose when it stops.
scenes.sub: A card in, a card out, plus 1 damage, two counters and a Wall. Sue and Reed both say 'may'.
scenes.say: One pass: a card in, a card out. Sue and Reed both say may, so you choose when it stops.

scenes.head: Run it before you attack
scenes.sub: Cast a noncreature spell, and the combat draw starts the loop before attackers. Twenty passes: 20 damage, and The Thing is a 47/47 trampler.
scenes.say: Mister Fantastic's combat draw starts it before attackers. Twenty passes: twenty damage, and The Thing is a forty-seven forty-seven trampler.

scenes.head: Alone, it's 1 damage a card
scenes.sub: Three opponents at 40 need 120 pings: more cards than your library holds. Two enchantments make the same loop lethal.
scenes.say: Alone, it's one damage a card: a table at forty needs a hundred and twenty. Two enchantments make it lethal.

scenes.head: [[Annie Joins Up]]: every trigger twice
scenes.sub: If a triggered ability of a legendary creature you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time. All Four are legendary.
scenes.say: Annie Joins Up: every trigger of a legendary creature you control happens twice, and the Fantastic Four are all legendary.

scenes.head: One card: two pings
scenes.sub: [[Human Torch, Johnny Storm|Human Torch]] triggers twice for every card you draw: 2 damage per card, not 1. Each ping picks its own target.
scenes.say: So each card you draw makes Human Torch trigger twice: two damage per card, not one.

scenes.head: The rest of the loop doubles
scenes.sub: Two pings: four Thing triggers, then up to eight Walls and sixteen Reed draws. All still 'may': take only what you need.
scenes.say: The rest doubles too: two pings make four Thing triggers. Then up to eight Walls and sixteen draws, every one optional.

scenes.head: [[Fiery Emancipation]]: every ping tripled
scenes.sub: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage instead. [[Human Torch, Johnny Storm|Torch's]] 1 is 3.
scenes.say: Fiery Emancipation triples the damage your sources deal, so each of [[Human Torch, Johnny Storm|Torch's]] pings becomes three.

scenes.head: Damage per card: 1, 2, 3 or 6
scenes.sub: Torch alone: 1. Annie: two pings of 1. Fiery: one ping of 3. Both: two pings of 3, or 6 a card.
scenes.say: Damage per card: one with Torch alone, two with Annie, three with Fiery. With both, two pings of three: six.

scenes.head: Cards to kill three opponents at 40
scenes.sub: Torch alone: 120. Annie: 60. Fiery: 42. Both: 21 cards, which is 42 pings of 3, fourteen for each opponent.
scenes.say: Three opponents at forty: a hundred and twenty cards, sixty with Annie, forty-two with Fiery, and twenty-one with both.

scenes.head: Both out: one spell starts the kill
scenes.sub: Cast a noncreature spell. With Annie, Mister Fantastic's combat draw triggers twice, and the Four do the rest: 21 cards.
scenes.say: With both out, cast one noncreature spell. Mister Fantastic's combat draw triggers twice, and the Four do the rest: twenty-one cards.

scenes.head: Missing one? Tutor for it
scenes.sub: [[Enlightened Tutor]] puts an artifact or enchantment card on top of your library. [[Idyllic Tutor]] puts an enchantment card into your hand.
scenes.say: Missing one? Enlightened Tutor puts it on top of your library, and Idyllic Tutor puts it into your hand.

scenes.head: More loops: counters on every draw
scenes.sub: [[Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards|Reed]] and [[Invisible Woman, Sue Storm|Sue]] loop with any Hero that puts a +1/+1 counter on a Hero when you draw. Here are three.
scenes.say: More loops. [[Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards|Reed]] and [[Invisible Woman, Sue Storm|Sue]] also loop with three Heroes that put a counter on a Hero whenever you draw.

scenes.head: [[Iron Man, Armored Avenger|Iron Man]]: a counter per card
scenes.sub: Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Aim it at any Hero but [[Invisible Woman, Sue Storm|Sue]], even Iron Man.
scenes.say: Iron Man puts a counter on target creature whenever you draw. Aim it at any Hero but [[Invisible Woman, Sue Storm|Sue]], even himself.

scenes.head: Reed, Sue and Iron Man
scenes.sub: Draw: Iron Man puts a counter on himself, Sue makes a 0/4 Wall, and the Wall makes Reed draw. Both 'may's let you stop.
scenes.say: Draw, and Iron Man puts a counter on himself. Sue makes a Wall, and the Wall makes Reed draw again.

scenes.head: Or [[Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings|Shang-Chi]], or [[The Astonishing Ant-Man|Ant-Man]]
scenes.sub: Each puts a +1/+1 counter on himself whenever you draw. Both are Heroes, so Sue can make a Wall every time.
scenes.say: Shang-Chi and Ant-Man each put a counter on himself whenever you draw, so Sue can make a Wall every time.

scenes.head: [[Pensive Professor]]: a card per counter
scenes.sub: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on it, draw a card. That draw isn't a 'may'.
scenes.say: Pensive Professor draws a card whenever +1/+1 counters are put on it, and that draw isn't optional.

scenes.head: Professor and Iron Man: two cards, one loop
scenes.sub: Draw: Iron Man puts a counter on the Professor, and the Professor draws. To stop, aim Iron Man's counter at another creature.
scenes.say: Each draw, Iron Man puts a counter on the Professor, and it draws again. To stop, aim the counter at another creature.

scenes.head: [[Human Torch, Johnny Storm|Human Torch]] cashes the cards in
scenes.sub: Whenever you draw, Torch pings target opponent for 1: every card from these loops is damage. With [[Annie Joins Up|Annie]] and [[Fiery Emancipation|Fiery]], 6.
scenes.say: Human Torch cashes the cards in: every card from these loops is a ping, and six damage with [[Annie Joins Up|Annie]] and [[Fiery Emancipation|Fiery]] out.

scenes.head: [[Unstoppable Plan]]: untap at your end step
scenes.sub: {2}{U} enchantment: at the beginning of your end step, untap all nonland permanents you control.
scenes.say: Unstoppable Plan: at the beginning of your end step, untap all nonland permanents you control.

scenes.head: The pieces: Mister Fantastic, the Plan, three rocks
scenes.sub: [[Chromatic Lantern]], [[Arcane Signet]] and [[Commander's Sphere]] each tap for one mana of any of your colours.
scenes.say: The pieces: Mister Fantastic, the Plan, and three rocks that each tap for one mana of any of your colours.

scenes.head: End step: Mister Fantastic copies the trigger
scenes.sub: Pay {R}{G}{W}{U} from your lands and tap him: copy the Plan's trigger twice. He must have been out since your turn began.
scenes.say: At your end step, the Plan triggers. Pay red, green, white and blue, and tap Mister Fantastic to copy it twice.

scenes.head: Each copy untaps everything
scenes.sub: The copies resolve first. Each untaps all your nonland permanents, Mister Fantastic and the rocks included. Tap the rocks after each one: 6 mana.
scenes.say: The copies resolve first. Each untaps Mister Fantastic and your rocks, so tap the rocks after each: six mana.

scenes.head: Copy it again: 2 mana kept every round
scenes.sub: Spend {R}{G}{W}{U} of it, tap Mister Fantastic, and target the Plan's trigger, still on the stack: two more copies. 2 mana is kept.
scenes.say: Spend four of the six, tap Mister Fantastic, and target the Plan's trigger again: two more copies, and two mana kept.

scenes.head: Spend it before the end step ends
scenes.sub: Repeat as you like; the mana empties when the step ends. With him untapped, [[Brainstorm]] for {U}: three Human Torch triggers.
scenes.say: Repeat as often as you like, and spend it before the step ends. Brainstorm draws three: three Torch triggers.

scenes.head: Copy the Plan, then the Torch: no limit
scenes.sub: Bank mana first. Then aim one activation at the Plan, for two untaps, and the next at a Torch trigger, for two pings. Repeat.
scenes.say: Now alternate: copy the Plan for two untaps, then a Torch trigger for two pings. With mana banked, repeat until the table is dead.

scenes.head: Mister Fantastic
scenes.sub: Bracket 4 · four-colour Hero combo · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Mister Fantastic. Bracket four, four-colour Hero combo. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
